description: We are engineering students participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, working on Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data. Our project, AgriSpace Karnataka, aims to support climate-resilient farming through NASA Earth observation data and crop-rotation analysis. We welcome passionate members interested in Python, AI/ML, software development, agriculture, GIS and satellite data. Join us and let's innovate together!
summary:
FIELD SHIFT – Adapting Farms with NASA Data
FIELD SHIFT is a climate-smart agricultural decision-support platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, focusing on farmers in Karnataka, India. Our project aims to help farmers make informed crop-selection and rotation decisions using NASA Earth observation data and local agricultural information.
The platform allows farmers to identify their agricultural land through an interactive map using GPS, village search, or manual location selection. It integrates NASA POWER climate data to analyze historical rainfall, temperature, and humidity patterns for the selected location.
By combining these environmental observations with farmer-provided information, including soil type, irrigation availability, planting season, and previous crops, the system evaluates crop suitability through a transparent rule-based recommendation engine. The prototype examines 20 crop options and identifies promising alternatives where sufficient supporting evidence exists, while highlighting data limitations.
Our goal is to make scientific climate information accessible to farmers, support water-efficient agricultural planning, encourage healthier crop rotations, and strengthen resilience against changing climatic conditions.
details: FIELD SHIFT is a climate-smart farming platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It uses NASA POWER climate data and farmer inputs to support crop selection and rotation planning. Farmers can select land locations and provide soil, irrigation, and crop details. Built using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and backend APIs, the project aims to deliver practical, data-driven recommendations, improve water efficiency, reduce climate risks, and promote sustainable agriculture in Karnataka.
